title: Counting sunflowers in hypergraphs with bounded matching number and Erdős Matching Conjecture in the $(t,k)$-norm
summary: It is well known that Erdős Matching Conjecture concerns the maximum number of hyperedges in an $r$-uniform hypergraph with bounded matching number. As a generalization, it is natural to ask for the maximum number of copies of subhypergraphs. Given integers $r\geq2$ and $k\ge 1$, let $S_{r-1,k}^r$ denote the $r$-uniform hypergraph with hyperedges $\{e_1, \dots, e_k\}$ such that there exists an $(r-1)$-set $T$ with $e_i \cap e_j = T$ for $1\le i < j \le k$.
